name: HeadersFooters
description: Contains all the HeaderFooter objects on the specified slide, notes page, handout, or master.
remarks: Each HeaderFooter object represents a header, footer, date and time, or slide number.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: DateAndTime
properties.description: Returns a HeaderFooter object that represents the date and time item that appears in the lower-left corner of a slide or in the upper-right corner of a notes page, handout, or outline. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideNumber
properties.description: Returns a HeaderFooter object that represents the slide number in the lower-right corner of a slide, or the page number in the lower-right corner of a notes page or a page of a printed handout or outline. Read-only.

properties.name: Header
properties.description: Returns a HeaderFooter object that represents the header that appears at the top of a slide or in the upper-left corner of a notes page, handout, or outline. Read-only.

properties.name: Footer
properties.description: Returns a HeaderFooter object that represents the footer that appears at the bottom of a slide or in the lower-left corner of a notes page, handout, or outline. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayOnTitleSlide
properties.description: Determines whether the footer, date and time, and slide number appear on the title slide. Applies to slide masters. Read/write.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the header and footer from the specified slide or slides.
